*Found one merge blocker* comparing `dedupe-imports` (`62644c3`) against `main`.

*P1 — Overlapping imports retain duplicate contacts* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` deduplicates objects by reference, not by `id`. Separate imports produce separate objects, so contacts with the same ID survive—contrary to the README’s first-seen-wins contract.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
```
Expected: only the first contact. Actual: both contacts.

Deduplicate using a set of seen IDs, retaining the first object. Add regression tests for distinct objects sharing an ID, both directly through `dedupe` and across lists through `mergeImports`.

All 4 existing tests pass, but none covers that overlap case; both targeted checks failed. No other findings. No files changed.
